text:
Aisha: Quick sync — planning a small canary deploy for the search-ranking tweak. Targeting today afternoon, want to confirm deploy owner, cohorts, and smoke checks.
Devon: I can own the deploy if Sam is on rollback/watch. What time window are we thinking?
Aisha: Thanks. Aim for 18:30 UTC. 30m pre-check, then staged ramps over ~45m. Does that work?
Priya: 18:30 UTC works for me. Proposed cohorts: 1) 0.1% global (synthetic traffic) 2) 1% US-west + EU-west 3) 5% target segments (logged-in free users) 4) 20% gradual open to all except enterprise-paid.
Sam: ++ on cohorts. I'll take smoke & rollback. What are our automated smoke checks?
Aisha: Smoke checklist: 1) 95th p99 latency < 350ms on search API 2) error rate < 0.3% 3) top-5 result novelty sanity (small eval run) 4) no increase in 4xx/5xx on auth proxy. We'll run synthetic suite and monitor dashboards.
Priya: Add: check embedding cache miss rate and KV cache size — the new ranking touches longer contexts.
Devon: Deploy command I plan to run: ```rictl deploy --svc search-ranking --image ghcr.io/redwood/search:canary-20260318 --canary=true --canary-steps "0.1,1,5,20" --cohorts "global-synth,us-west-eu-west,free-loggedin,open-except-paid"```
Sam: Good. I will be on pager 18:20–19:30 UTC. I'll run smoke script: ```scripts/smoke_search_canary.sh --target http://canary.search.internal --runs 1000 --check-latency 350``` and have rollback ready.
deploy-bot: Build succeeded for ghcr.io/redwood/search:canary-20260318 — image ID sha256:abc123def456. CI tests: 48/48 passed.
Aisha: If smoke passes at 0.1% after 5m, we move to 1% and re-evaluate after 8m. If anomalies at any stage (latency spike or error burst), we pause and rollback to previous stable.
Devon: How do we handle regional capacity? If US-west has high load, do we skip 1% for that region?
Priya: Yes — routing policy: we can exclude region via flags. Plan: if region CPU > 70% or p95 latency baseline increases > 15%, skip cohort and notify.
Sam: Rollback command (ready): ```rictl rollback --svc search-ranking --to stable --reason "canary-failure"``` I'll also run: ```kubectl -n prod rollout undo deploy/search-ranking``` if needed.
Devon: I'll update the deployment doc and add runbook notes to the thread before 18:00 UTC.
Aisha: Friendly reminder — tag @oncall and add the canary link to the incident playbook for quick triage. Also keep an eye on cost anomalies in console.
Priya: I'll pre-seed the synthetic traffic and start the eval harness at 18:25 UTC.
Sam: I'll post a status update after each step: 0.1% -> pass/fail, 1% -> pass/fail, 5% -> pass/fail, then final.
Aisha: Thanks team. If no blockers, proceed to deploy at 18:30 UTC. :thumbsup:
Devon: LGTM — will start rollout and ping here at first-step.
Sam: Ready on my end.
Priya: Standing by.
Aisha: Closing loop — ping here when done and include final metrics (p99, errors, KV cache hit).
Sam: 18:29 UTC — prechecks done, smoke infra ready.
Devon: 18:31 UTC — started 0.1% canary.
